title: The Catacomb Abyss
blurb: Raycast first-person shooter from id co-founder John Carmack's Softdisk era; cast spells, blast undead.
legal_evidence: Catacomb Adventure Series source + games released as freeware by Flat Rock Software / id; widely redistributed as freeware.
completeness_evidence: This is the complete standalone freeware game (all levels via EGAGRAPH.ABS/GAMEMAPS.ABS data), not a teaser.

title: Ken's Labyrinth
blurb: Goofy pre-Build-engine raycaster by Ken Silverman (later author of Duke3D's Build engine).
legal_evidence: Ken Silverman released Ken's Labyrinth as freeware (and the source) on his official site advsys.net/ken.
completeness_evidence: Silverman's freeware release covers all 3 episodes; KEN.EXE launches the full game.

title: Bio Menace
blurb: Snake Logan vs. mutant-infested Metro City; Keen-engine arcade action by Jim Norwood.
legal_evidence: Apogee/3D Realms released Bio Menace as freeware (3drealms.com freeware list, 2005).
completeness_evidence: Freeware release includes all 3 episodes — BMENACE1.EXE, BMENACE2.EXE, BMENACE3.EXE are all present (use CHOICE.EXE to pick).

title: God of Thunder
blurb: Zelda-like top-down puzzle-combat starring Thor, by Ron Davis / Adept (Software Creations).
legal_evidence: Released as freeware by author Ron Davis / 3D Realms (on 3drealms.com freeware list).
completeness_evidence: Freeware release is the complete game — all three quests bundled in GOTRES.DAT, launched by GOT.EXE.

title: Jill of the Jungle
blurb: Epic MegaGames' colorful jungle platformer; transform into a phoenix, frog, and fish.
legal_evidence: Official Epic MegaGames shareware episode 1 (Jill of the Jungle), freely redistributable.
completeness_evidence: Only episode 1 (JILL1.EXE) is cleanly redistributable as shareware; episodes 2-3 were sold and aren't in this freely-distributable set.

title: Supaplex
blurb: Collect Infotrons and dodge Zonks/Snik-Snaks across 111 fiendish levels.
legal_evidence: Rights holders (Dream Factory / digital-integration) released Supaplex as freeware; distributed free via supaplex.online and elxsoft.
completeness_evidence: Full game — all 111 levels in LEVELS.DAT; SUPAPLEX.EXE runs directly (INSTALL.EXE optional, not required).

title: Stargunner
blurb: Polished side-scrolling shmup with upgradeable weapons, the last DOS game Apogee published.
legal_evidence: 3D Realms / Apogee released Stargunner as freeware in 2005 (3drealms.com freeware section).
completeness_evidence: This is the official full freeware release (all episodes); files sit at zip root, STARGUN.EXE launches the complete game.

title: Realms of Chaos
blurb: Apogee fantasy platformer; switch between warrior Andrew and sorceress Elandra.
legal_evidence: Official Apogee shareware (ROCSW = Realms of Chaos ShareWare); freely redistributable.
completeness_evidence: Shareware episode only — the full game was a commercial release; ROCSW.EXE is the shareware build.

title: Dark Ages
blurb: Early Apogee EGA platformer trilogy; Prince Garloth battles the wizard Garn.
legal_evidence: Official Apogee shareware (episode 1 freely distributed; episodes 2-3 included as DA2/DA3 in this freeware-era bundle).
completeness_evidence: Episode 1 (DA1.EXE) is the redistributable shareware; bundle also carries DA2/DA3 dirs but episode 1 is the canonical shareware play.

title: Commander Keen: Marooned on Mars
blurb: The shareware-era classic that put id Software on the map; 8-year-old Billy Blaze saves Earth.
legal_evidence: Official id Software / Apogee shareware episode 1 (Marooned on Mars), freely redistributable.
completeness_evidence: Episode 1 only; the full Invasion of the Vorticons trilogy is still sold (Steam/GOG), so only the shareware episode is distributable.

title: ZZT
blurb: Tim Sweeney's ASCII-graphics adventure and editor — the game that founded Epic MegaGames.
legal_evidence: Epic Games released ZZT as freeware in 2002 (Tim Sweeney / Epic, via the Museum of ZZT and Epic's blessing).
completeness_evidence: Full freeware release including all worlds and the editor; ZZT.EXE at root runs the complete registered game.

title: Jetpack
blurb: Adept Software's jetpack-fueled gem-collector with a built-in level editor.
legal_evidence: Author Adam Pedersen / Adept Software released Jetpack as freeware (jetpack.adeptsoftware.com).
completeness_evidence: Freeware release is the full registered Jetpack (all 100+ levels + editor), not the shareware subset.

title: Math Rescue
blurb: Apogee math-learning platformer; recover stolen numbers from the Gruzzles.
legal_evidence: Apogee/3D Realms released Math Rescue as freeware (3drealms.com freeware list).
completeness_evidence: Freeware release includes all 3 episodes (MR1/MR2/MR3.EXE present; CHOICE.EXE selects).

title: Word Rescue
blurb: Companion to Math Rescue; match words to pictures while dodging Gruzzles.
legal_evidence: Apogee/3D Realms released Word Rescue as freeware (3drealms.com freeware list).
completeness_evidence: Freeware release includes all 3 episodes (WR1/WR2/WR3.EXE + WRPLUS.EXE; CHOICE.EXE selects).

title: Xargon
blurb: Allen Pilgrim's Epic platformer (a Jill-of-the-Jungle successor); explore three worlds as Malvineous.
legal_evidence: Author Allen H Pilgrim released the full Xargon trilogy as freeware (publicly distributed with his blessing).
completeness_evidence: This is the freeware trilogy — all three episodes (XRFILE01/02/03.EXE) launched via XARGON.BAT, not just shareware episode 1.

title: Monster Bash
blurb: Johnny Dash rescues kidnapped pets from Count Chuck's monster mansion; spooky Apogee platformer.
legal_evidence: Apogee/3D Realms released Monster Bash as freeware (3drealms.com freeware list).
completeness_evidence: This BASH123 build contains all 3 episodes (BASH1/BASH2/BASH3.EXE), the full freeware release rather than shareware episode 1 only.

title: Alien Carnage (Halloween Harry)
blurb: Flamethrower-toting Harry torches aliens and frees hostages; fast SubZero/Apogee action.
legal_evidence: 3D Realms / SubZero released Alien Carnage (Halloween Harry) as freeware in 2007 (3drealms.com).
completeness_evidence: Filename 'alien_carnage(full)' is the full freeware release (all 4 levels); CARNAGE.EXE at zip root runs the complete game.

title: Pharaoh's Tomb
blurb: Whip-cracking Nevada Smith raids a booby-trapped tomb; early Apogee George-Broussard title.
legal_evidence: Official Apogee shareware; episode 1 (PTOMB1) freely redistributable (this freeware-era bundle carries all 4 levels).
completeness_evidence: Episode 1 (PTOMB1.EXE) is the shareware play; PTOMB2-4 dirs present but episode 1 is the canonical distributable shareware.

title: Boppin'
blurb: Quirky block-matching puzzler starring Yeet and Boik; 3D Realms / Accursed Toys.
legal_evidence: 3D Realms / Accursed Toys released Boppin' as freeware in 2005 (3drealms.com freeware section).
completeness_evidence: Freeware release is the complete registered game (all 50+ levels); BOPPIN.EXE runs the full version.

title: Death Rally
blurb: Remedy's breakthrough debut: weaponized top-down racing with a young Max-Payne-era pedigree.
launch_cmd: INSTALL.EXE (then run RALLY.EXE from install target)
legal_evidence: Remedy/Apogee released the original Death Rally as freeware in 2009 (officially, via Remedy's site and 3D Realms).
completeness_evidence: Official full freeware release of the complete game; this archive is the original installer set (DR1._1.._5 + INSTALL.EXE).
